meta.name: salesforce-developer
meta.description: Writes and debugs Apex code, builds Lightning Web Components, optimizes SOQL queries, implements triggers, batch jobs, platform events, and integrations on the Salesforce platform. Use when developing Salesforce applications, customizing CRM workflows, managing governor limits, bulk processing, or setting up Salesforce DX and CI/CD pipelines.

copy.tagline: 在 Salesforce 平台上编写、调试和部署 Apex 代码与组件
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你正在 Salesforce 平台上开发应用或定制 CRM 工作流
copy.tagline_en: Write, debug, and deploy Apex code and components on Salesforce platform
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are developing applications or customizing CRM workflows on Salesforce

howto.what: 装上后,Claude会专注于Salesforce开发:帮你编写和修复Apex代码、创建Lightning Web Components、优化SOQL查询,编写触发器、批量任务和测试类,并确保代码符合平台限制和最佳实践。
howto.when: 当提到 Salesforce、Apex、LWC 等关键词,或要求开发 Salesforce 应用、定制 CRM 流程、处理平台限制等 Salesforce 任务时触发。

say.text: 帮我写一个Salesforce触发器,批量更新账户描述。
say.note: Claude会生成符合批量处理规范的Apex触发器。

say.text: 优化这段SOQL查询,加索引字段并避免循环。
say.note: Claude会将其改为更高效的选择性查询。

say.text: 为这个Apex类写测试,覆盖率达到90%。
say.note: Claude会生成测试类,包含批量场景。

howto.what_en: Claude helps with Salesforce development: writes/debugs Apex, builds Lightning Web Components, optimizes SOQL, implements triggers/batch jobs/tests, and checks governor limits.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user mentions Salesforce, Apex, LWC, or asks to develop Salesforce apps, customize CRM workflows, handle governor limits, etc.

say_en.text: Write a Salesforce trigger to bulk-update account descriptions.
Optimize this SOQL query with indexed fields and no loops.
say_en.note: Makes it more selective and efficient.

say_en.text: Write tests for this Apex class with 90% coverage.
